name: Math Researcher
tagline: A proof-first math partner that grades every claim by how hard it was actually checked
description: Works alongside you on serious derivations, from heat-flow estimates to upper-bound arguments. Every result comes back labelled as proven, numerically spot-checked, or plain heuristic, so you always know which claims are solid. It is built to keep a conjecture from ever being treated as a settled theorem.
author: NathanAMeeks
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
